method: Android UIAutomator bounds from the capture moment; original PNG pixels for glyph ink, card edges, shadows and hairlines (px × 160 / density = dp). Design values are measured from design/*.png at 2× (px / 2 = pt). Web values come from the live DOM at DPR 1.

V1.rule: paddingBottom = max(insets.bottom, 34) (40 on Onboarding); this device's gesture inset is smaller, so the block ends 34 / 40 dp above the screen edge
V1.keyboard: signin-keyboard-390-light, signup-keyboard-360/390-light: the block stays below the form and scrolls with it; no field is covered (flexGrow content, marginTop auto, KeyboardAvoidingView unchanged).
V1.measuredLive: Sign in, Sign up and Onboarding at 360/390/430 were measured on the release build without capturing (the matrix holds 360 and 390 Sign in, 390 Sign up and Onboarding).

V2.at360: Pocket Wi-Fi renders 117.4 dp wide at 17/22 and the row leaves 113 dp, so it wraps to two lines beside the pills (the design allows two). The design's own values leave 115 pt at 360 for its 115.5 pt label. At 390 every label in the fixture is on one line with the pills.
V2.pillWidthNote: Pills measure 57.7 / 72.3 dp against the design's 56.5 / 71.5 pt: Android sets the labels ~1 pt wider than Chrome.

V3.note: Track edges against the first note card: 0.0 dp in dark; ±0.7–1.0 dp in light is the card's 1 dp shadow edge, not the card.
V3.labelsAt360: All · 3, Shared · 2, Only you · 1 on one line, untruncated (notes-360-light/dark).

V5.note: The input is flex: 1 and Stamp ready a non-shrinking sibling, so typed text scrolls inside the input and cannot run under it.

V7.design: Courier Prime 700 13/16, ink2, no letter-spacing, not uppercase

design.stamp: top 11, right 11 inside a card at the 24 pt column

V8.messageLine: One line at 360, 390 and 430, as drawn: the fixed sample message has no right padding (the design keeps it on one line in a 74 pt card); the header, which carries the typed name, keeps 30 pt clear of the stamp.

design.at390: six in full, the seventh cut

V9.openScroll: Plan opens on today when it falls within the trip. plan-{360,390,430} were captured on 11 Oct, so SUN 11 (the ninth stamp) was selected on open and the strip scrolled to show it with 16 dp after it; WED 7 was then tapped. plan-today (8 Oct clock) opens on THU 8, which is on screen, so the strip is not scrolled.
